summary.title: Intel® Xeon® 6 with P-Cores Configuration and Tuning Guide for HPC Applications
summary.one_liner: Learn BIOS and Linux settings, plus build and run recipes, for tuning HPC applications on Intel Xeon 6 P-core processors.
takeaways: General BIOS and Linux configuration guidelines apply to all HPC applications on Xeon 6 P-core processors.
The guide includes build and run recipes for a selected set of HPC applications and benchmarks.
Use it as a starting point for tuning and optimizing HPC workloads on Intel Xeon 6 with P-cores.
summary.summary: This Intel guide gives tuning and optimization guidelines for HPC applications running on Intel Xeon 6 processors with P-cores. It covers general BIOS and Linux configuration that applies across HPC workloads. It also includes step-by-step build and run instructions (recipes) for a selected set of HPC applications and benchmarks. The page text available is mostly a short description and access notice, so specific settings are not listed here.
